notes.notes:
*Fixed issue where Xbox controllers where being assigned to both the first and second player slots.
*Changed and rebalanced various boss fights.
*Fixed hit detection of enemies with spinning objects.
*Improved various sprites and backgrounds.
*Added the costume shop and new costume sets.
*Added 3 new holiday events and improved some old events. 
*Other small improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: The 4th of July
notes.notes: During the month of July you can find Uncle Sam by the garage. Talk to him to unlock some holiday themed costumes.

notes.title: Happy Easter!
notes.notes: During the month of April you can find the Easter Bunny by the garage. Talk to him to unlock some holiday themed costumes.

notes.title: Happy Holidays
notes.notes: During the month of December you can find the Santa Claus by the garage. Talk to him to unlock some holiday themed costumes.

*Bug fixes.
*Various sprite and background improvements.
*Disabled leaderboard (until I get it back up or replaced).

notes.title: Update Notes for Oct 13th 2022
notes.notes:
*Bug fixes
*Sprite tweaks
*Minor buffs and nerfs to some bosses.

notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.notes: During the month of October you can find the Grim Reaper by the garage. Talk to him to unlock some Halloween themed costumes.

*Bug fixes.
*Fixed easy mode soft lock.
*2nd Player input tweak.
